movelist.name: Poison Tail
movelist.effect: Poison Tail is a Critical Hit on 18+, and Poisons the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Lick
movelist.effect: Lick Paralyzes the target on 15+ during Accuracy Check.

movelist.name: Wrap
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Venoshock
movelist.effect: If the target is Poisoned, Venoshock has a Damage Base of 13 (4d10+10 / 35) instead.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Shed Skin
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one of Paralysis, Freezing, Burns, Poison, or Sleep.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to Stealth Checks, does not trigger Hazards, Blessings cannot be activated in response to its actions, and the user may bypass the effects of the move Substitute.
